title: Compose a screen from refs and review it
trigger: A ticket asks for a new screen.
goal: The screen uses tokens and components only and renders without unresolved refs.
outcome: A screen with stable node ids, flows wired, and no red outlines.

steps.action: Reads the design system at view tree
Writes the screen with write_html, refs only
Takes a screenshot and fixes red outlines before the next write
Shows the new screen in the preview within a moment
